releaseNotes:
• Daily Login Consistent Streak: Interactive animated daily streak check-in button with fire explosion, morphing dot, weekly streak row addition, and automatic 12:00 AM midnight refresh
• Daily Streak Widget Integration: Seamless launch of the Daily Streak modal from the Android home screen widget
• Dynamic Reasoning & Thinking Budgets: Configurable thinking budgets with Gemini 2.5/3 and Claude 3.7
• Intelligent Context Compaction: Auto-summarizes extended multi-turn sessions preserving active goals and file diffs
• Interactive Requirements Clarification: New 'ask_question' agent tool with interactive selection cards in chat
• Workspace URI Canonicalization & Slash Commands System (/explain, /fix, /refactor, /test, /doc, /review, /commit, /commands)
